name: Dr Smita Jauhari
institute: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology
qualification: PhD, South Gujarat University, Surat, India
interests: Water Chemistry ,Water adsorbent materials, Synthetic Organic Chemistry, Polymers, Corrosion
bio: Smita Jauhari is a Professor in Applied Chemistry Department, and has over 19 years of teaching and research experience. Her current research interest is in: Water Chemistry with focus on Quality of water and treatment of Industrial wastewater. Synthetic organic chemistry for pharmacological application and corrosion. Synthesis of Polymer from renewable source of energy. Her research accomplishment includes she has more than 43 publications in peer–reviewed international journal. She has authored three book chapters.. She has successfully supervised several PhD students. She has successfully completed an externally funded project and has a patent to her credit.
